author: Yffe
content: Batch doc-only fix of the five pinned findings #218-#222 in RATIONALE.md + README.md (single commit, ref #217). #218: correct 4 README anchors to GitHub double-hyphen slugs (verified by a scripted slugifier over the actual headings, 11/11 resolve). #219: rewrite cage Limits — seccomp-BPF DOES filter scalar args[0..5], the true limit is no pointer dereference (TOCTOU); Direction made consistent. #220: drop old(_) (no such construct; ens ranges over result + params), fix Per/postconditions typo. #221: spine trust base to 5 items matching audit.sh check [6], Lean kernel + 3 axioms as item 1. #222: restore the survey's per-claim novelty hedge across preamble + all three extension notes. Cause-level: corrected the docs to match the authorities (GitHub slugger, seccomp man-page mechanics, spec grammar, audit.sh, SOTA survey).
